title: Freeze functional iteration scope and capability matrix
purpose: Freeze the post-Alpha functional capability matrix so later work grows through contracts, AgentCore workflows, SecurityExecution authority, and operator projections.
scope: List user-visible AgentOS capability families after Distribution Alpha.
Map each family to owner crate/module, semantic tools, policy risk, audit projection, rollback/fail-closed behavior, and release gate.
Declare non-goals and blocked shortcuts, especially direct agentd-only implementation and normal-mode shell execution.
Create a capability matrix document that subsequent tasks must update.
implementation_steps: Create a matrix row for package manager, untrusted content, Firecracker execution, operator UX, diagnostics/support bundle, update/rollback, and audit export.
For each row, assign a primary owner and an integration path.
Define baseline local-only acceptance and optional dependency behavior.
Record risks and explicit non-goals in evidence JSON.
acceptance_criteria: Every capability has exactly one primary owner and clear integration layers.
No capability is allowed to bypass SecurityExecutionEngine for side effects.
The matrix states the local-only replay path and optional dependency behavior.
The matrix links to follow-up TASK-FUNC tasks.
verification: Grep the matrix for owner entries for runtime_contracts, agent_core, security_execution, agentd, scripts, and packaging.
failure_modes: Agentd becomes the owner of adapter business logic.
A capability requires external LLM, network, Firecracker, or host package manager for baseline acceptance.
Rollback or fail-closed behavior is omitted.

blocked_until: Capability matrix is written and evidence is parseable.
